availability_policy: NOAA object LastModified and nominal bulletin time plus 30 minutes must precede checkpoint; decoded reference time must also precede checkpoint. Market candle end must precede checkpoint. Historical per-market rules are assumed applicable to the archived event and are not claimed to be a contemporaneous rules snapshot.
target_policy: Archived market rules must name Central Park and NWS Climatological Report (Daily). Use each market's expiration_value, reconcile all bin results, and compare against NCEI daily TMAX without excluding score cases based on agreement. Daily window uses EST local standard time; NDFD daytime MaxT is a predictor transformed through training residuals.
scope_reason: One city and three consecutive summer months provide a bounded historical prototype. Dates and all analysis settings were selected before held-out market records or scores were inspected. June 1 was the source/schema pilot. All dates and both horizons are inventoried, with failures retained.
limitations: Single city and summer season; this is not evidence of general year-round or cross-city performance.
Archive metadata supports reconstruction, not proof of all information available to a real-time trader.
Historical rules may have later updates; original publication snapshots are not available.
Hourly candle bid/ask closes do not establish executable fills or historical depth.
NDFD grid daytime maximum differs from the station's full-day maximum.
One month of holdout dates limits statistical precision; null and adverse findings are retained.
